{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索封蜡信记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"修伞人更换一根竹骨，按旧价收取铜钱，与送信路线无关。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-P2AB","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A23949b9f-66bc-4588-b625-1b95bdb78945:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:23949b9f-66bc-4588-b625-1b95bdb78945"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["修伞人更换一根竹骨，按旧价收取铜钱，与送信路线无关。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"叶遥只读到被换入的纸条，相信母亲去了南城；方鹭看过原信，知道母亲留在北城。方鹭核对原信与纸条，决定带原信去邮会办理纠正。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-P2AB","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A8578b11a-bc9a-40b6-afef-5134dfcf8fef:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:8578b11a-bc9a-40b6-afef-5134dfcf8fef"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["叶遥只读到被换入的纸条，相信母亲去了南城；方鹭看过原信，知道母亲留在北城。方鹭核对原信与纸条，决定带原信去邮会办理纠正。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"方鹭展示原信，邮会纠正收信记录；叶遥未到场，仍依据先前读到的纸条订了南行船票。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-P2AB","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aa7e99dd8-8f7d-4257-a6d7-28c480a20a11:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:a7e99dd8-8f7d-4257-a6d7-28c480a20a11"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["方鹭展示原信，邮会纠正收信记录；叶遥未到场，仍依据先前读到的纸条订了南行船票。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"母亲的原信写着她将留在北城，红蜡信封里却被人换入写着她要去南城的纸条。邮会规约要求：纠正收信记录必须展示原信，口头传闻不能更改。信封边沿有一圈细小的花纹。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-P2AB","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Acf54af7c-73e7-41ef-9a41-722913e4c69c:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:cf54af7c-73e7-41ef-9a41-722913e4c69c"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["母亲的原信写着她将留在北城，红蜡信封里却被人换入写着她要去南城的纸条。邮会规约要求：纠正收信记录必须展示原信，口头传闻不能更改。信封边沿有一圈细小的花纹。"]}]}
